appDescription: A pickup assistant that recommends a safe place for the vehicle to stop and pick up a passenger.

function.name: REQUEST_PICKUP
function.description: Request to pick up a passenger, optionally near a given place.

passenger.description: Name of the person to pick up, as the driver says it (for example a contact name or a relationship like mom).

place.description: Name of the place near which the pickup is wanted. Omit to use the current location.
